title: Page 5
content_zh:
龙焱瞪着她反问：“你说云腿有问题，你怎么确定？”
“我闻到的！”枣儿天生嗅觉敏锐，凡她嗅过的东西，她绝对不会错辨。
真的假的？龙焱眉一皱，喊住了王二。“先等一等。”然后他望向枣儿。“证明给我看。”
她要怎么证明？枣儿回头，灶房里每个人的眼神都那么可怕，一副她证明不出，就要拆了她骨头熬汤的狠样。枣儿心一慌，脱口就把他底泄了出来——
“您身上有药材味道，还有，您染了风寒。”
“你在说什么啊你！”王二首先发难，因为连他也嗅不出龙焱身上有什么药材味，鬼才染了风寒！
第2章(2)
龙焱终于信了她。“把‘鸡包翅’端来。”
“龙爷？！”王二吓了一跳。
“剪开。”云腿就同鱼翅鲍鱼填在鸡肚子里，开口正是用海带丝细心缝合。
海带丝一断，里头咸汤混着鱼翅鲍鱼滑出。龙焱挟了块云腿往王二嘴里一塞。“怎么样？”
王二嚼了嚼，然后呸呸吐了出来。
大伙儿一脸惊奇地瞪着枣儿。
龙焱倏地转身。“灶上还有什么？”
“白片鸡。”三厨答。
“快拿出来。”
好在“一条龙”灶房总会备着几道费功夫的大菜。龙焱手拿白刀飞快地拆鸡切片，最后再浇上一匙鲜浓的老母鸡炼汤，香菜末一撒。
“‘白片鸡’上桌。”四厨接过大喊。
“‘白片鸡’上桌。”
一桩祸事，总算及时挡了下来，尤其王二后来得知座上宾客是谁，吓得魂差点飞了。只差那么一点，“一条龙”这招牌就毁在他手上啊！

当晚，饭庄门一关上，账房马上领枣儿来见龙焱。
进门的枣儿一瞟桌上菜盘，忙道：“打扰您用膳了。”
“不碍事。”反正他也没什么胃口。“你坐。”
枣儿怯生生坐下，不是刻意打探，但眼儿鼻子却一下子便把桌上菜肴认了个清楚——一盘腊笋千层肉跟一份虾爆鳝，汤是熬得骨离肉糜的清鸡汤，看得出灶上对龙焱病体的用心，可他们却忘了，染了风寒的病人，胃口不开，再闻油腥，只会更觉食欲不振。
“别光盯菜盘。”龙焱轻敲桌面要枣儿抬头。“我唤你来，是要谢谢你救了‘一条龙’。”
枣儿连连摇手。“龙爷千万别这么说，能够帮庄里一点忙，是我的荣幸……”
龙焱打断枣儿的谦词，转开话题。“我听余盛说你已经开始学削皮。”
“是。”事儿头一点。
“你是真心想学割烹？”他再确定。
“是。”
“好。”他头一点。“从明儿开始，下工之后，你到我跨院，我会每天按部就班传授你所有的割烹手艺。”
若不是中午一闹，龙焱到现在还不晓得原来石草竟有如此天赋，一想到恩师传贤不传子的交代，不须犹豫，他马上决定收石草为徒。
正好石草年纪也小，磨练个几年，他想，该就可以交出“一条龙”担子，安心退隐了。
枣儿不敢相信自己的耳朵——她不会是听错了吧？
“话说在前，我是个严格的师父，只要你的表现不合我意，我随时会要你滚出去——”他睇了她一眼。“听清楚了？”
很清楚。只见她愣愣地点点头，但是，她脑子一下子还转不过来。
“既然听清楚了，还坐着做什么？”龙焱板起脸。“还不跪下拜师。”
龙焱一凶，枣儿心就慌了，只见她活似听话的娃儿，他一说跪她就跪，说磕头就磕头。直到她额碰地，一个声音才扎扎实实地进到她脑袋——
龙爷要收她做关门弟子！人称“易牙再世”的庖人说要收她为徒，天呐！
枣儿一颗心涨得，活似一蹬脚，就能飘上天一样。

她急忙拧拧自己脸颊，好确定自己不是在作梦。可龙焱几句话，又倏地将她拉回现实。
“回去跟你爹说，明天开始，你搬进来‘一条龙’。”
这样一来，龙焱想，夜里他就有更多时间训练这小子了。
“你刚说你答应了什么？”石老庐一脸震惊。
端坐在椅上的枣儿怯怯地复述：“我刚说，我拜龙爷做师父，他要教我割烹……”
“你你你……”石老庐头都晕了。“龙爷知道你是姑娘了吗？”
枣儿摇头。
我的天呐！石老庐抱头呻吟。“我明明千交代万叮咛，龙爷最忌女人进他灶房，你竟然还答应他这种事，我真的是……”
“我不知该怎么拒绝嘛！”她自己也苦恼极了。
待初时的兴奋过去之后，她才知道自己惹了什么麻烦。混在“一条龙”灶房，她只是一个极不起眼的小庖厨，说难听点，她哪时候不见了龙焱或许都不会发现；可一拜龙焱为师之后，情况就不一样了。
“听爹一句，明早就去回了它。”石老庐不愿看自个儿女儿身陷泥淖、抽身不得。早先她瞒着身分进“一条龙”替工，若被人发觉追究，勉勉强强还能拿一番孝心当借口，可拜龙爷为师，已经构得上恶意欺瞒了。
石老庐是老实人，一想到骗，他就全身不舒坦。
“大不了辞了‘一条龙’的工，等爹腰伤痊愈，爹再另想办法挣钱。”
一听这话，枣儿倏地吓白了脸。“不行的。”
“为什么不行？”
“因为……”枣儿一时语塞。脑中浮现的理由，是她想留在龙焱身边，她还想多见他几面，不想这么早就跟他分开，可这心底话，她实在没办法说出口。
石老庐想当然误会了。“我知道你心疼爹，但爹心意已决，明天你也不用上工了，爹亲自过去辞了这工……”
“不要！”枣儿大喊一声，一急，眼泪忽地落了下来。
“你是怎么了啊？”石老庐被枣儿的眼泪吓了一跳。她一直是个欢快的孩子，就连当年她娘病逝，她也没在他这个爹面前哭过几回。
“爹……”枣儿唤了一声，知道自己再不吐实，她今后，或许再也没机会见龙焱了。“女儿老实告诉您，女儿，喜欢龙爷。”

石老庐再愣。“你刚说你什么？”
“我喜欢龙爷。”她豁出去了。“我知道您接下来一定会说我跟龙爷身分不配，我是在痴人说梦，但我就是……”
“龙爷知道吗？”
“当然不知道。”她连连摇头。“我也没想让他知道……”
看着女儿又哭又笑的脸，石老庐总算了解了——难怪她会不高兴金家人过来提亲，原来是因为她心里早有人了。
石老庐脑中浮现龙焱俊逸过人的长相，还有那双深不见底的黑瞳。也难怪女儿会喜欢，这男人，确实是人中之龙。
“爹，算我求您，”枣儿一脸恳切。“您就让我在他身边多待一阵子，再待一阵子就好……”
石老庐长叹口气。“就算爹愿意让你留在龙爷身边，但万一被龙爷知道你是女儿身……”
“我考虑不了那么多……”枣儿抱着头。
龙焱身上有她最渴望的东西，不单单是他的人，还有他那身无人能敌的厨技。光一样就足够将她迷得晕陶陶，何况这会儿，还是两者兼具。
“我可怜的孩子……”石老庐老泪纵横地挲着女儿头顶。全都得怪他，没能给她一个好环境，让她光明正大接近喜欢的对象。“你知道你挑了一条多难的路子？别说咱们跟龙爷有着云泥之差，就单你瞒着他入了他灶房，他将来知道，一定会认为你是故意骗他……”
她抬起哭湿的脸庞。“那您教教我，我该怎么做才好？”
content_en:
Long Yan stared at her and asked, "You said there is something wrong with Yun's legs. How can you be sure?"
"I smelled it!" Zao'er was born with a keen sense of smell, and she would never misidentify anything she smelled.
Real or fake? Long Yan frowned and called out to Wang Er. "Wait a minute." Then he looked at Zao'er. "Prove it to me."
How can she prove it? When Zaoer turned around, everyone in the kitchen looked at her with terrible looks, as if she was going to tear her bones apart and make soup if she couldn't prove it. Zaoer panicked and blurted out her secrets——
"You smell like medicinal herbs, and you have a cold."
"What are you talking about?" Wang Er was the first to attack, because even he couldn't smell any medicinal smell on Long Yan's body, so it was only the devil who caught the wind and cold!
Chapter 2(2)
Long Yan finally believed her. "Bring over the 'chicken-wrapped wings'."
"Master Long?!" Wang Er was startled.
"Cut it open." The cloud legs are stuffed into the chicken belly with shark fin and abalone, and the opening is carefully sewn with kelp silk.
When the kelp thread is broken, the salty soup mixed with shark fin and abalone slides out. Long Yan took a piece of cloud leg and stuffed it into Wang Er's mouth. "How's it going?"
Wang Er chewed it and then spat it out.
Everyone stared at Zao'er in surprise.
Long Yan turned around quickly. "What else is on the stove?"
"White sliced chicken." The third chef replied.
"Take it out quickly."
Fortunately, the "one-stop" kitchen always prepares several dishes that require a lot of effort. Long Yan quickly cut the chicken into slices with a white knife in his hand. Finally, he poured a spoonful of fresh and thick old hen soup and sprinkled with coriander.
"'White Chicken' is on the table." The fourth chef took over and shouted.
"'White Chicken' is served."
A disaster was finally prevented in time, especially when Wang Er later learned who the guests were, he was so frightened that he almost flew away. Just a little bit away, the "one-stop" brand will be destroyed in his hands!
That night, as soon as the restaurant door closed, the accountant immediately brought Zaoer to see Long Yan.
Zao'er, who came in, glanced at the dishes on the table and said hurriedly: "I'm disturbing your meal."
"It's okay." He didn't have much appetite anyway. "Sit down."
Zao'er timidly sat down and didn't deliberately pry, but his eyes and nose immediately recognized the dishes on the table - a plate of preserved bamboo shoots, thousand-layer meat and a portion of fried eel with shrimps. The soup was a clear chicken soup that was boiled to the bone and minced meat. It was obvious that the stove was caring for Long Yan's sick body, but they had forgotten that patients infected with wind and cold would not have an appetite. If they smell the oily smell, they will only feel more loss of appetite.
"Don't just stare at the dishes." Long Yan tapped the table to ask Zao'er to look up. "I called you here to thank you for saving 'a dragon'."
Zaoer waved her hands repeatedly. "Master Long, please don't say that. It's an honor for me to be able to help the village..."
Long Yan interrupted Zaoer's humble words and changed the topic. "I heard from Yu Sheng that you have started learning to peel."
"Yes." That's the first thing.
"Do you really want to learn Kappo?" he confirmed again.
"Yes."
"Okay." He nodded. "Starting from tomorrow, after work, you come to my hospital, and I will teach you all the kappo skills step by step every day."
If it hadn't been for the incident at noon, Long Yan still wouldn't have known that Shi Cao had such a talent. When he thought of his mentor's instructions to pass on talents to his sons, he immediately decided to accept Shi Cao as his disciple without hesitation.
Shi Cao happened to be young, and after a few years of hard work, he thought he would be able to hand over the "one-stop" responsibility and retire with peace of mind.
Zaoer couldn't believe her ears - could she have heard wrong?
"First of all, I am a strict master. As long as your performance is not to my liking, I will ask you to get out at any time-" He glanced at her. "Did you hear that clearly?"
Very clear. She nodded blankly, but her mind couldn't turn around.
"Now that you heard it clearly, why are you still sitting there?" Long Yan said with a straight face. "You still haven't knelt down to worship me."
When Long Yan was fierce, Zaoer panicked. She looked like an obedient child. She knelt down whenever he asked her to., If you say kowtow, kowtow. It wasn't until her forehead touched the ground that a voice entered her head solidly——
Master Long wants to accept her as a closed disciple! The chef known as "Yi Ya Reincarnated" said that he would accept her as his apprentice, oh my God!
Zao'er's heart swelled, as if she could float to the sky with just one kick.
She hurriedly pinched her cheek to make sure she wasn't dreaming. But Long Yan's few words quickly brought her back to reality.
"Go back and tell your father that starting tomorrow, you will move in as a 'one-stop'."
In this way, Long Yan thought, he would have more time to train this kid at night.
"What did you just say you promised?" Shi Laolu looked shocked.
Zao'er, who was sitting in the chair, timidly repeated: "I just said that I worship Lord Long as my master, and he wants to teach me how to cut and cook..."
"You, you, you..." Shi Laolu felt dizzy. "Does Mr. Long know that you are a girl?"
Zaoer shook his head.
OMG! Shi Laolu held his head and groaned. "I've told you countless times that Master Long is most afraid of women entering his kitchen, yet you actually allowed him to do such a thing. I'm really..."
"I don't know how to refuse!" She herself was extremely distressed.
After the initial excitement wore off, she realized what trouble she had gotten into. In the "Yilong" kitchen, she was just a very inconspicuous little cook. To put it bluntly, Long Yan might not notice her when she disappeared; but after becoming a disciple of Long Yan, the situation was different.
"Listen to dad, I'll go get it back tomorrow morning." Shi Laolu didn't want to see his daughter trapped in the mud and unable to get out. Earlier, she had concealed her identity as a substitute for "Yilong". If someone found out and pursued her, she could barely use her filial piety as an excuse. However, becoming a disciple of Mr. Long would already amount to malicious deception.
Shi Laolu is an honest man, and when he thinks of cheating, he feels uncomfortable all over.
"The worst case scenario is that I'll quit my job as a one-stop shop. After my father recovers from his back injury, he will find another way to make money."
Upon hearing this, Zaoer suddenly turned pale with fright. "It won't work."
"Why not?"
"Because..." Zao'er was speechless for a moment. The reason that came to mind was that she wanted to stay with Long Yan, she wanted to see him more, and didn't want to be separated from him so early, but she really couldn't express what was in her heart.
Shi Laolu took it for granted that he had misunderstood. "I know you feel sorry for Dad, but Dad has made up his mind. You don't have to go to work tomorrow. Dad went over and quit the job in person..."
"No!" Zao'er shouted, and tears suddenly fell down in a hurry.
"What's wrong with you?" Shi Laolu was startled by Zao'er's tears. She has always been a cheerful child. Even when her mother died of illness, she never cried in front of her father a few times.
"Dad..." Zao'er called, knowing that if she didn't tell the truth, she might never have the chance to see Long Yan again. "Daughter, I tell you honestly, my daughter likes Mr. Long."
Shi Laolu was stunned again. "What did you just say about you?"
"I like Mr. Long." She gave up. "I know you will say next that Master Long and I are not worthy of each other. I am talking nonsense, but I just..."
"Does Mr. Long know?"
"Of course I don't know." She shook her head repeatedly. "I didn't want him to know either..."
Looking at his daughter's crying and laughing face, Shi Laolu finally understood - no wonder she was unhappy that the Jin family came to propose marriage. It turned out to be because she already had someone in her heart.
Long Yan's handsome appearance and those bottomless black pupils appeared in Shi Laolu's mind. No wonder my daughter likes him, this man is indeed a dragon among men.
"Dad, let me beg you," Zao'er said with a sincere expression. "Just let me stay with him for a while longer..."
Shi Laolu sighed. "Even if dad is willing to let you stay with Mr. Long, if Mr. Long finds out that you are a daughter..."
"I can't think about that much..." Zao'er held her head.
Long Yan has what she desires most, not only his people, but alsoHis cooking skills are unmatched. The same light was enough to make her dizzy, not to mention that at this moment, it was both.
"My poor child..." Shi Laolu Lao burst into tears, stroking the top of his daughter's head. It's all his fault for not giving her a good environment to let her approach the person she likes openly. "Do you know what a difficult path you have chosen? Don't tell me that there is a huge difference between us and Master Long. If you just entered his kitchen without telling him, he will definitely think that you deliberately lied to him if he finds out in the future..."
She raised her face that was wet with tears. "Then please teach me what should I do?"
